products.name: Talking Cactus
products.short: The cheeky little cactus that repeats what you say, dances, sings and lights up. Giggles guaranteed.
products.description:
Say something and the Talking Cactus says it right back in a giggly voice, then wiggles and dances. Switch to music mode for a playlist of catchy songs with flashing lights. It's soft, cheeky and impossible not to smile at.

Little ones love hearing their own voice played back, so it turns babbling into a game. It's great for tummy time, car trips and nappy changes, and it gets a big reaction as a baby shower gift.
features: Repeats what you say in a funny voice
USB rechargeable, so no batteries to buy
Volume switch with a quieter setting
products.age: Check the age rating on the packaging. Always supervise play and don't leave it in a cot.
